# `gravel`

Gravel for floors: small rounded stones packed on earth.

![gravel](../images/gravel.png)

Category: [grounds](../catalog.md#grounds).

Own size: 64 × 64 pixels. Parameters marked **layout** are expressed at this size and scale with the patch; **detail** parameters are real pixels and never scale. See [Layout and detail](../concepts.md#layout-and-detail).

## Parameters

### General

| Parameter | Type                            | Default    | Scale  | Description                                           |
| --------- | ------------------------------- | ---------- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `size`    | [width, height] of integers > 0 | `[64, 64]` | —      | own size of the patch, in pixels                      |
| `grain`   | number in [0, 1]                | `0.06`     | detail | random brightness variation between pixels, in [0, 1] |

### `stones`

Small rounded stones, packed.

| Parameter          | Type                            | Default                                        | Scale  | Description                                                            |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `stones.count`     | integer ≥ 1                     | `90`                                           | layout | stones in the patch                                                    |
| `stones.variation` | number in [0, 1]                | `0.6`                                          | —      | spread of the stone sizes, in [0, 1]; 0 gives stones of a similar size |
| `stones.palette`   | array of CSS colors, at least 2 | `["#3b3834", "#5d5953", "#837e76", "#a9a399"]` | —      | colors of the stones, from darkest to lightest                         |
| `stones.shift`     | number in [0, 1]                | `0.35`                                         | —      | random shift of each stone along the palette, in [0, 1]                |
| `stones.relief`    | number in [0, 1]                | `0.85`                                         | —      | roundness of the stones, in [0, 1]: domes lit from the top-left        |
| `stones.gap`       | number ≥ 0                      | `1`                                            | detail | earth showing between the stones, in pixels                            |

### `dirt`

Bare earth: blotches, clods and pebbles.

| Parameter       | Type                            | Default                                        | Scale  | Description                                           |
| --------------- | ------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `dirt.palette`  | array of CSS colors, at least 2 | `["#2e2217", "#4a3726", "#654b33", "#80623f"]` | —      | colors of the earth, from darkest to lightest         |
| `dirt.blotches` | number > 0                      | `4`                                            | layout | large blotches across the patch                       |
| `dirt.contrast` | number in [0, 1]                | `0.6`                                          | —      | spread of the blotches over the palette               |
| `dirt.clods`    | number ≥ 0                      | `8`                                            | —      | lighter lumps of earth per 32 × 32 pixels             |
| `dirt.pebbles`  | number ≥ 0                      | `3`                                            | —      | pebbles per 32 × 32 pixels                            |
| `dirt.grain`    | number in [0, 1]                | `0.14`                                         | detail | random brightness variation between pixels, in [0, 1] |
| `dirt.wetness`  | number in [0, 1]                | `0`                                            | —      | damp earth, darker, in [0, 1]                         |

## Usage

`gravel` is a ground, for floors: `stones.count` small rounded stones of every size,
packed on earth. They are the cells of a power diagram, like the boulders of
[`cavewall`](cavewall.md): `stones.variation` spreads their sizes, and
`stones.relief` rounds them into domes lit from the top-left. `stones.gap` lets the
earth, set by the `dirt` group, show between them.

```json
{ "template": "gravel", "stones": { "count": 40, "variation": 0.9 } }
```

## Example

```json
{
  "$schema": "../../schemas/patch.schema.json",
  "template": "gravel",
  "size": [64, 64]
}
```
